stem: Plants worked heavily yesterday show widespread drooping today, while an untouched comparison section does not. What is the best technician response?
choices: Document the work intensity and recovery difference, check relevant environment/root-zone context, and escalate if outside expected recovery
Repeat the same heavy work immediately
Assume all drooping is normal after training
rationale: Comparison with an untreated section provides useful evidence. Recovery should be monitored rather than assumed.
